label: Missed Pickup - DNA
applies_when: The pickup was not attempted and is recorded as Missed Pickup - DNA.
scope_notes: The reviewed code card does not expand the DNA abbreviation or independently authorize missing a pickup.

label: P/U Not Ready - Dispatch Again
applies_when: The pickup was attempted but the packages were not ready and dispatch should be requested again.
locator: page 2, Pickup Attempted but Not Completed, Code 10; OP-117 page 52

label: Closed - Attempted, No Packages
applies_when: The pickup was attempted at a closed location and no packages were obtained.
scope_notes: Does not establish that every on-site cancellation qualifies.
This is different from delivery Code 011 for a non-residential weekend closure.
locator: page 2, Pickup Attempted but Not Completed, Code 11; OP-117 page 52

label: Interline
applies_when: The FORGE pickup-reason list shows Code 13 as Interline; the reviewed source does not define the exact operating condition.
scope_notes: Definition only: do not select this code without current station guidance or a source defining the exact condition.
locator: page 52, FORGE Select a reason code screen, Code 13

label: Weather
applies_when: The pickup was not attempted because of weather.
scope_notes: The definition does not independently establish who must approve the weather condition.

label: Residential Pickup, Not Home
applies_when: A residential pickup was attempted but the recipient was not home.
locator: page 2, Pickup Attempted but Not Completed, Code 15; OP-117 page 52

label: Holiday/Contingency/Local Event
applies_when: The pickup was not attempted because of a holiday, contingency, or local event.
scope_notes: MGB-119 shortens the label to Holiday; the FORGE screen in OP-117 shows holiday/contingency.
locator: page 2, Pickup Not Attempted, Code 16; OP-117 page 52

label: Hazmat - Pickup Not Made
applies_when: A pickup was not made because of a hazardous-material condition.
scope_notes: This definition does not replace the applicable hazmat safety and escalation procedure.
locator: page 2, Pickup Not Attempted, Code 17; OP-117 page 52

label: Attempted - Customer Confirms No Package
applies_when: The pickup was attempted and the customer confirms there are no packages.
scope_notes: OP-117 identifies this as a payable pickup attempt.
The reviewed page establishes the code meaning but not every documentation field or complete FORGE sequence.

label: Express Pickup - Cancel
applies_when: An Express pickup was attempted but is canceled.
locator: page 2, Pickup Attempted but Not Completed, Code 21; OP-117 page 52

label: P/U Cancelled - No Attempt Made
applies_when: The pickup was canceled and no attempt was made.
scope_notes: This differs from delivery Code 024 for a call-tag package that is not ready.

label: Wrong Address - Pickup Not Made
applies_when: The pickup was not attempted because the pickup address was wrong.

label: Pickup Not Scanned
applies_when: The pickup was attempted but was not scanned.
scope_notes: OP-117 separately states Code 26 should be used when a pickup is not scanned because of scanner failure.
locator: page 2, Pickup Attempted but Not Completed, Code 26; OP-117 page 62, scanner failure
